catalog: USDA FoodData Central — USDA Global Branded Food Products Database (GBFPD)
publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service, Beltsville Human Nutrition Research Center

basis: The download page offers these archives for download without registration or a licence click-through: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/download-datasets/

FoodData Central is a U.S. Government work published by a federal agency. Under 17 U.S.C. §105, copyright protection does not extend to works of the U.S. Government; no copyright notice or restricted-use licence is attached to the downloadable files.

The GBFPD documentation states that product information is received from food-industry data providers and that the data are downloadable and searchable at fdc.nal.usda.gov: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/GBFPD_Documentation.html
The published base is bounded to the selected product rows and aggregate measurements; no provider-private fields, customer data, receipts, or card data exist in the source files.
Attribution and the suggested citation are carried by every plate and by the generated report.
redistribution.attribution: U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central: USDA Global Branded Food Products Database. Internet: fdc.nal.usda.gov.
redistribution.recheck: Re-read the download page, the GBFPD documentation and this record before changing either pinned archive; stop the build if the terms cannot be re-verified.

model.name: minilm
model.note: Category labels are retained as metadata and never passed to clustering.

emeans.subsampling: none: every training vector is used each epoch

analysis.objective: held-out squared L2 on unit-normalized embeddings, loss from final-centroid reassignment
analysis.evaluation_split: sha256(fdc_id) first byte < 204 → held out; the rest trains
